fact: The land information system at the Land Administration Authority records plot position, boundaries, owner, use and transactions, using ArcGIS, SOLA and Landfolio, but cannot provide an electronic database on encumbrances.
title: Land Governance in Lesotho
publisher: R. C. Leduka, M. Ntaote, S. N. Takalimane, National University of Lesotho (NELGA)
